subject.title: macOS 27 Tahoe beta: Keychain C API silently writes 0 bytes — file keyring workaround required

question: Should gogcli treat macOS 27 beta as a documented temporary file-keyring fallback while native Keychain compatibility is investigated, or prioritize an immediate supported native-Keychain repair?
rationale: The report identifies a real authentication-storage failure, but choosing between documentation, a targeted fallback, a dependency replacement, and signing-entitlement changes requires an explicit macOS support and compatibility decision.

options.title: Document and investigate
options.body: Recommend a Tahoe-beta troubleshooting note that points to the existing file keyring, while reproducing the native Keychain path on the current release before changing credential-storage implementation.

options.title: Prioritize native repair
options.body: Treat Tahoe Keychain compatibility as immediate platform support work and fund a targeted backend or signing investigation with macOS regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Document and investigate
recommendation.body: Recommend a Tahoe-beta troubleshooting note that points to the existing file keyring, while reproducing the native Keychain path on the current release before changing credential-storage implementation.
